Deposit $50 of USDC into SUBFROST on Bitcoin and use its main feature once a week. Cost: $50 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote, and never let a week pass with no activity. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 90 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 90 days.
Open the protocol's own points or rewards page once a week and check that your activity is being counted. Cost: no fee to check. Time: 10 minutes a week.
If a token is announced, claim only from the link the protocol itself publishes, and never pay anyone to claim for you. Cost: no fee to check; gas only at claim time. Time: 15 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log, and decide in advance at what price you will sell half. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
